entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 1.22 +/- 0.04 solar radii from Sulis et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 73344 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...688A..14S/abstract); Mass 1.2 +/- 0.02 solar masses from Sulis et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 73344 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...688A..14S/abstract); temperature from Sulis et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 73344 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 6,252.6 K and log g 4.34 (u1 0.376, u2 0.305): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
